description: Na₂ThF₆ is alpha bismuth trifluoride-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Immm space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.47 Å. Th⁴⁺ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight F¹⁻ atoms. There are four shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.40 Å) Th-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Th⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Th₂ tetrahedra. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Th⁴⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Th tetrahedra.
